## Invitations

A total of 2355 people were invited during the reporting period. Attendance was 269, representing a rate of 11.4 per cent. The attendance figure is recorded against the number invited and provides the basis for reviewing the reach of the invitation activity.

The results indicate that participation was lower than the number of invitations issued. The figures should be retained for monitoring and for comparison with other outreach activity. They also provide a clear record of the number invited, the number attending, and the resulting rate.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 1994 invitees. Reminders were recorded as 0. These figures should be considered alongside the invitation and attendance totals when reviewing the contact process.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments. This remains part of the follow-up activity associated with the outreach work.

Prepared by G. Evans.
